summary: The filing is BBVA's first-quarter 2026 earnings release, submitted as Form 6-K to the SEC. It contains financial results, forward-looking statements, and standard disclaimers. There are no transaction-specific terms, no acquisition or divestiture announcements, no activist or strategic review, and no capital return or restructuring. The document is an ordinary periodic report. The registrant is the issuer, reporting routine earnings. No special-situation classification applies.
